title: Claims Bulletin: Guest Payments and the Deductible on HostCover Theft Claims, by Level
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover).** On a theft claim, the HostCover level decides how the guest payments recorded on the claim, net of reversals, are shared between Roamhaven and the host. In this bulletin, the adjusted theft loss is the theft loss being settled before guest payments and the deductible come off it, and the deductible is the deductible the theft claim bears.

## Sharing method by level

- **HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite and HostCover Estate.** The guest payments first restore the deductible the theft claim bears, so only the larger of those payments and that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted theft loss.
- **HostCover Standard and HostCover Plus.** The guest payments are shared in proportion to the parts of the loss each side bears, so the deductible is subtracted from the adjusted theft loss together with the guest payments multiplied by the adjusted theft loss less the deductible (never below 0.00) and divided by the adjusted theft loss.
- **Any other level (HostCover Essential).** The guest payments and the deductible are both subtracted from the adjusted theft loss.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: adjusted theft loss 2000.00, deductible 250.00)

| Level group | Guest payments 600.00: amount subtracted | Left | Guest payments 100.00: amount subtracted | Left |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Premier, Elite, Estate | 600.00, the larger of 600.00 and 250.00 | 1400.00 | 250.00, the larger of 100.00 and 250.00 | 1750.00 |
| Standard, Plus | 250.00 plus 600.00 multiplied by 1750.00 and divided by 2000.00, that is 775.00 | 1225.00 | 250.00 plus 87.50, that is 337.50 | 1662.50 |
| Essential | 600.00 plus 250.00, that is 850.00 | 1150.00 | 100.00 plus 250.00, that is 350.00 | 1650.00 |

On the Standard and Plus line, 1750.00 is the adjusted theft loss less the deductible, and the ratio 1750.00 to 2000.00 is the part of the loss the guest payments are credited against.
